# Validate external operator onboarding

## Intent

As a prospective publication operator outside Anthus AI Solutions, I want to start and use a newsroom pod with minimal assistance, so that we can test whether the pod is a credible on-ramp rather than only an internal tool.

## Entry criteria

- A reusable pod package has passed internal use.
- The participant, support boundary, success measures, and treatment of their content are agreed in advance.

## Definition of Done

- An external operator initializes or receives a pod and advances a real story.
- Time to first useful result, coaching comprehension, blocked-transition recovery, human support, and abandonment points are recorded.
- Internal workflow success and funnel evidence are reported separately.
- The result makes an explicit decision about onboarding changes, professional-services positioning, and whether another external trial is warranted.

## Non-goals

- Treating internal dogfooding as customer validation.
- Building hosted-scale capabilities to rescue the local experiment.
- Claiming conversion from a single successful trial.
